title: RossFast temporal-estimator structure, cancellation and independent holdout qualification

live_canonical_at_start.relevant_model_certificate_semantics: available AND finite AND indicator >= 0 AND indicator <= 1

research_question: Determine whether the D3G02 factor-1 conservativity failure is consistent with a reproducible multi-level discretization/cancellation pattern across new forcing holdouts, or whether the finest full-vs-two-half estimator lacks a stable relation to independently referenced error on the bounded RossFast research domain.

new_holdout_domain.rationale: D3G02 scientific calibration used nominal forcing only. The two predeclared +/-1 percent variants are new temporal-estimator holdouts while remaining inside the frozen D2 bounded 2 percent forcing envelope.

precommitted_interpretation.meaning_of_positive_signal: Supports only a later separately preregistered estimator-model study. It does not qualify a safety factor, tolerance, certificate, production path or G02 closure.
precommitted_interpretation.negative_signal: If any frozen structural condition fails, record the failing material/attempt/forcing cases and stop certificate-model evolution on this route unless a new scientific hypothesis is independently justified.

anti_overfit_rules: No thresholds may be chosen after viewing D3G02R holdout results to turn failure into pass.
The known D3G02 ratio 1.6 may motivate this structural study but may not be used as a fitted factor or acceptance threshold.
Holdout variants may not be dropped after execution.
Mass, ownership, reference-consistency and scope failures may not be traded against temporal accuracy.
